spec.title: Aggregations / sec
spec.description: Successful RAV aggregations per second, all instances.

spec.title: Failures / sec
spec.description: Failed aggregation requests per second. Covers every rejection reason -- bad signer, timestamp, collection id mismatch.

spec.title: Receipts / sec
spec.description: Individual receipts folded into RAVs per second.

spec.title: GRT Aggregated / hr
spec.description: total_aggregated_grt is an f64 counter in wei (server.rs:63-68); above ~2^53 wei it loses integer precision. Good for trend, not for reconciliation.

spec.title: Success Ratio
spec.description: Reads 0% when there is no traffic at all.

spec.expr: 100 * (sum(rate(aggregation_success_count{job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / clamp_min((sum(rate(aggregation_success_count{job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) + (sum(rate(aggregation_failure_count{job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)), 1e-9)

spec.title: Receipts per RAV
spec.description: Batching efficiency. A collapse toward 1 means indexers are requesting aggregation far more often than they need to.

spec.title: Kafka Publish Failures / sec
spec.description: Every failure here means a RAV was returned to the indexer but never reached the gateway_ravs topic, so escrow debt accounting drifts (server.rs:536).

spec.title: Instances Up
spec.description: Scrape target count. Does not prove the RPC port is serving -- the metrics server binds at main.rs:105, before the private key is parsed at line 108.

spec.title: Aggregation Rate
spec.description: Failures climbing while successes stay flat is the signature of a signer rotation gone wrong -- previous_rav rejected by aggregator.rs:29-35.

spec.expr: 100 * (sum(rate(aggregation_success_count{job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / clamp_min((sum(rate(aggregation_success_count{job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) + (sum(rate(aggregation_failure_count{job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)), 1e-9)

spec.title: GRT Aggregated per Hour
spec.description: increase() rather than the raw counter, so process restarts do not read as a cliff.

spec.title: Kafka Publish Rate
spec.description: Absent entirely when --kafka-config is unset: the publish path is guarded by `if let Some(kafka)` and the counters never register.

spec.title: Kafka Publish Failure Ratio
spec.description: Sustained non-zero means escrow debt is being under-counted and deposits will lag real usage.

spec.expr: 100 * (sum(rate(kafka_publish_failure_total{job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / clamp_min((sum(rate(kafka_publish_success_total{job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) + (sum(rate(kafka_publish_failure_total{job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)), 1e-9)

spec.title: Version Errors
spec.description: JSON-RPC only -- incremented at server.rs:158, which the gRPC handlers never reach. Flat zero is expected if all your traffic is gRPC.

spec.title: Deprecation Warnings
spec.description: JSON-RPC only (server.rs:167). Also stays zero while GRAPH_TALLY_RPC_API_VERSIONS_DEPRECATED is empty.

spec.title: Scrape Up
spec.description: The prometheus crate is built without the `process` feature, so there are no process_cpu/rss/start_time series to chart here.

spec.title: Detected Restarts
spec.description: Counter resets as a restart proxy. There is no uptime metric, and the aggregator logs nothing after its three startup lines, so this is the cheapest restart signal available.

spec.title: Graph Tally aggregator logs
spec.description: Expect three lines at startup and silence thereafter -- there is no per-request logging on the gRPC path.

spec.name: job
spec.label: Job
spec.description: Aggregator deployment to display. Keyed off `up` because every aggregator counter is lazy-registered and absent before first use; set the regex to narrow this list.
